question: Let $A$ be a finite set and $R$ an equivalence relation on $A$. The number of distinct equivalence classes under $R$:
explanation:
Number of equivalence classes is equal to the number of partitions of $A$.

The minimum number of equivalence classes is 1 (when all elements belong to one class).

The maximum number is $|A|$ (when each element forms its own class).

Hence the number of equivalence classes is at least 1 but at most $|A|$.

options.D: always at least 1 but at most $|A|$
